ArmCommand: Arm-level command wrapper selecting one arm control mode (joint, cartesian, impedance, or gravity compensation).
BodyCommand: Whole-body command wrapper selecting a body control mode (joint, cartesian, impedance, optimal, or component-based).
BodyComponentBasedCommand: Component-level body command combining left/right arm and torso commands.
CartesianCommand: Cartesian pose targets with optional joint position targets.
CartesianImpedanceControlCommand: Cartesian impedance control with pose targets and joint limit settings.
CommandHeader: Common header for command requests and responses.
ComponentBasedCommand: Top-level component command combining mobility, body, and head commands.
FactoryResetAllParametersRequest: Request to factory reset all parameters.
FactoryResetAllParametersResponse: Response for factory reset all parameters.
GetControlManagerStateRequest: Request to get control manager state.
GetControlManagerStateResponse: Response for get control manager state.
GetFaultLogListRequest: Request to get fault log list.
GetFaultLogListResponse: Response for get fault log list.
GetPositionPIDGainRequest: Request to get position pid gain.
GetPositionPIDGainResponse: Response for get position pid gain.
GetRobotStateStreamRequest: Request to get robot state stream.
GetRobotStateStreamResponse: Response for get robot state stream.
GetSerialDeviceListRequest: Request to get serial device list.
GetSerialDeviceListResponse: Response for get serial device list.
GravityCompensationCommand: Hold current pose while compensating gravity.
GripperInitializationRequest: Initialize a gripper by name and prepare it for motion.
GripperMoveRequest: Move a gripper to a target position with velocity/force limits.
GripperMoveResponse: Result of a gripper move request.
ImpedanceControlCommand: Cartesian impedance control around a reference pose/trajectory.
JogCommand: Single-joint jog command for absolute, relative, or step motion.
JointGroupPositionCommand: Position targets for a named joint subset.
JointImpedanceControlCommand: Joint-space impedance control with stiffness/damping settings.
JointPositionCommand: Joint-space position targets with optional velocity/acceleration limits.
JointVelocityCommand: Joint-space velocity targets with optional acceleration limits.
MobilityCommand: Base mobility command (wheel joint velocity or SE2 velocity).
OptimalControlCommand: Whole-body optimal control with weighted task objectives.
RealTimeControlCommand: Real-time control request with direct joint/pose targets.
RequestHeader: Common header for request requests and responses.
ResetAllParametersToDefaultRequest: Request to reset all parameters to default.
ResetAllParametersToDefaultResponse: Response for reset all parameters to default.
ResetParameterToDefaultRequest: Request to reset parameter to default.
ResetParameterToDefaultResponse: Response for reset parameter to default.
ResponseHeader: Common header for response requests and responses.
RobotCommand: Top-level robot command wrapper for whole-body, component-based, or jog control.
RobotCommandRequest: RPC request wrapper for sending a robot command with priority.
RobotCommandResponse: RPC response wrapper for a robot command.
SetPositionPIDGainRequest: Request to set position pid gain.
SetPositionPIDGainResponse: Response for set position pid gain.
SetToolFlangeDigitalOutputRequest: Request to set tool flange digital output.
SetToolFlangeDigitalOutputResponse: Response for set tool flange digital output.
StopCommand: Immediate stop request with no target motion.
ToolFlangePowerCommandRequest: Request to tool flange power command.
ToolFlangePowerCommandResponse: Response for tool flange power command.
TorsoCommand: Torso subsystem command (posture, cartesian, impedance, or optimal control).
WaitForControlReadyRequest: Request to wait for control ready.
WaitForControlReadyResponse: Response for wait for control ready.
WholeBodyCommand: Whole-body command wrapper for stop or real-time control.
